name: photo-denoise
desc: Free, open-source photo denoiser for Windows — clean high-ISO night shots with local models, batch folders. 100 MB portable, offline, MIT.
features: ✅ **Local denoise models** — ONNX networks clean ISO 6400 shots without a subscription or an upload
✅ **Detail guard slider** — balance between smearing skin and leaving chroma noise, with a zoom loupe
✅ **Shadow boost** — lift dark areas after denoising so night shots stay readable
✅ **Batch night shoots** — a folder of hundreds of RAWs or JPEGs processed overnight
✅ **Before and after loupe** — 200 percent zoom comparison follows your cursor
✅ **EXIF preservation** — camera metadata kept intact through the whole pipeline
✅ **100 MB self-contained exe** — runtime bundled, models download separately, offline after that, MIT
compare: | Feature | **photo-denoise** | Topaz DeNoise | Lightroom denoise | RawTherapee |
| Price | **Free, MIT** | Paid | Subscription | Free, OSS |
| Detail guard control | **Yes** | Partial | Partial | Manual
| Portable, no install | **Yes, 100 MB** | Installer | Installer | Installer
faqQ: free AI denoise for noisy high-ISO photos on Windows?
faqA: Paid denoisers cost more than the lens and Lightroom needs a subscription plus uploads nothing but your patience. photo-denoise runs local models with a detail guard and processes whole night shoots in batch. It is a 100 MB portable exe, MIT, offline, and keeps your EXIF data untouched.
s1: Dark darkroom (#121417, cyan #0E7490): before and after panes of a night street shot at 200 percent loupe, detail guard slider at 0.65, ISO 6400 badge.
s2: Batch panel: 480 RAW files queued from one shoot, progress at 39 percent, per-file status dots, output folder chip set to final.
s3: Comparison loupe: cursor-following zoom inset showing noise before and texture after, shadow boost at plus 0.4, EXIF preservation checked.
